svg.text: DAC-EK, version 2 (working draft): two strands joined by knowledge objects, rising with every turn
who made it · when · from what · human or model
Machine strand (the means): Data, Algorithms, Compute, Energy
Meaning strand (the ends): Information, Knowledge, Wisdom, Action
Rungs are knowledge objects, where NeoLibrary does its work
Rob Tyrie · v1 DAC-EK, Mar 14, 2025 · v2 working draft, Oct 17, 2026 · Meaning strand after the DIKW hierarchy (Ackoff, 1989)
